case: domain-over-enum array CSV import with a same-named shadow domain in search_path
contract: CSV import planning uses the target table's qualified domain array type even when search_path puts an identically named domain first.
The imported row preserves the native domain-array type, text, JSON and array_send bytes, and an existing sibling row remains unchanged.

domain_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration domain_contract:: -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other domain-array import configurations and PostgreSQL consumer combinations remain open in B3.
